The XPRESS fixture contains four successful 4096-byte level-1 cases extracted from ms-compress/tests/fixtures/xpress-oracle.wxp. Expected bytes were decoded by the independent wimlib C oracle at upstream revision cd5e231c348c255ae5088873b5a66ee0eb96fa07. The WXP1 record format retains names, compressed inputs, and exact expected outputs. These generated cases cover the batched WOF test; they do not establish Windows capture correctness.
